desc:
You volunteer yourself to help and check on your friend's progress with getting the required battery, that will serve as an attempt of stopping zombies from infecting other survivors. To get the battery and return back to your base safely, you will have to go through a school infested with zombies.
There are over 19 challenging stages in this OBBY.


Please note: This game is not meant to be classified as a scary OBBY, but it includes jumpscares.
Game inspired by PlatinumFalls' obbies.
Background music: Roblox's sound library.
